description: November 1 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 1, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 1 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the first decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Pluto as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: November 1 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: November begins with the Sun at around eight degrees of Scorpio, the late part of the Pluto decan. The birthday number 1 adds independence and drive to an already intense placement. Traditionally, this reads as a self-directed investigator, someone who pursues a goal with focus, prefers to keep plans private until they are ready and dislikes being rushed.

On November 1 the Sun usually sits at about 8° Scorpio, in the first decan, where Pluto rules the decan as well as the sign. Pluto rules Scorpio in modern astrology and also governs its first decan, so late October and the first days of November hold the sign in concentrated form. This decan is traditionally associated with intensity, privacy and a capacity to go deep into whatever it touches, whether a relationship, a mystery or a personal reinvention. Trust tends to be slow and, once given, complete. Doubled Pluto can bring a strong will and a reluctance to show vulnerability. Natives often find their power in honest transformation: releasing what no longer fits rather than guarding it out of habit.

sections.heading: November 1 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 1st, your birthday number is a plain 1, with no compound behind it. In Pythagorean numerology the day of birth is a secondary number, a talent or flavour that sits alongside the Life Path rather than replacing it. A first-of-the-month birthday is traditionally read as the purest form of initiative: a self-starting streak, a preference for making decisions personally and a comfort with going first. Because there is nothing to reduce, the energy is often described as direct and uncomplicated. The usual counsel is to pair that independence with listening, so leadership does not become lonely.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one November 1 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on November 1: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 1 is the 305th day of the year (306th in a leap year). By November 23, 22 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Sagittarius.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by November 1, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on November 1 include Aishwarya Rai (1973), Edward Said (1935) and Süleyman Demirel (1924).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 1?
faq.answer: November 1 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Pluto.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 1?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 1 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 1st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 1?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a November 1 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 1?
faq.answer: November 1 is also the birthday of Aishwarya Rai (1973), Edward Said (1935) and Süleyman Demirel (1924). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
